description.value: Green Leaf Vietnamese Bistro is an authentic Vietnamese restaurant with three locations across British Columbia, including this Duncan outpost along the Trans-Canada Highway. The menu spans a wide range of Vietnamese classics — pho noodle soups, fresh spring rolls, vermicelli bowls, rice plates, and specialty dishes — all crafted from fresh, premium ingredients. Touring cyclists passing through Duncan will find it a convenient full-service meal stop with online ordering and dine-in reservations available.
